description: Turn any technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill — ready to study, reference, and use while you work.
readme_excerpt: 1. **Point** it at a file, folder, or glob — /book-to-skill ./my-book.pdf 2. **It distills** the book into a skill — frameworks, decision rules, anti-patterns, and per-chapter files.
